API Connections
C
Claude AI (Anthropic)
Powers all four agents — PR, Marketing, Sales, Brand
Not set
Get a key at console.anthropic.com →
SH
Shopify
Live order data, revenue, customer info, inventory sync
Not set
How to connect →
The Admin token lives server-side only — it never enters this browser. In Netlify → Site configuration → Environment variables add SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN (e.g. veniacollection.myshopify.com) and SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN (the shpat_… token from Admin → Apps → Develop apps), then redeploy and test. The app reads orders through a server proxy that only ever performs read-only requests.
✉
Email — send as VENIA
Pull sheets go out from VENIA instead of whichever account your phone happens to use
Not tested
Empty = each of you sends as yourself — Keeter's device from Keeter, Christine's from Christine. Nothing to verify, and the cc keeps you both in the loop.
A fixed address must be the signed-in Google account or one of its verified “Send mail as” aliases in Gmail, on every device — Gmail replaces anything else with that account's own address.
Every pull sheet is copied here, so a pull is never only in one person's outbox. Leave empty for none.
How to connect →
Gmail (no extra service). Uses the same Google sign-in as Drive, with one added permission. Tap Connect Gmail and sign in with the account that owns info@veniacollection.com. If that address is an alias rather than the account itself, add it in Gmail → Settings → Accounts → “Send mail as” first, or Gmail will substitute the account's own address.
Two things can block it: the Gmail API must be enabled for your Google Cloud project, and gmail.send is a sensitive scope — on an External consent screen the signing account has to be listed as a test user. Google's own error is shown here if either bites.

Or a mail service instead. A mailto: link cannot choose the sender — the phone's mail app uses its own default account, which is how a pull sheet went out from a personal address. Sending as VENIA needs a server:
1 · Create an account at resend.com and add veniacollection.com as a domain — it gives you SPF and DKIM records to paste into your DNS.
2 · Once the domain shows verified, create an API key.
3 · Netlify → Site configuration → Environment variables → add RESEND_API_KEY. Optionally set MAIL_FROM to change the display name; it defaults to VENIA Collection <info@veniacollection.com>.
4 · Redeploy, then test here.

Until then, pull sheets still open as a draft in your mail app — the app will say so rather than implying VENIA sent it.
ST
Stripe
Deposits & card holds for stylist pulls — payment links from the Finish Checkout sheet
Not tested
How to connect →
The secret key lives server-side only: Netlify → Site configuration → Environment variables → add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (from dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys), then redeploy and test.
G
Google — one account for everything
Drive, Calendar and Gmail all sign in once, as the same account
Not set
How to connect →
In Google Cloud Console, one project covers both Calendar and Drive:
1. APIs & Services → Library → enable Google Calendar API, Google Drive API and Google Picker API.
2. → Clients → create a Web application client. Authorized JavaScript origin: https://creator.veniacollection.com. Paste the Client ID above.
3. On the consent screen add scopes calendar.events (planner writes events) and drive.file (Enigma reads only the files you pick).
4. → Credentials → Create credentials → API key (an AIza… string — NOT the Client ID). Paste it in the Picker field below.
When creating the key: under API restrictions tick Google Picker API and Google Drive API — if they are not in the list, they are not enabled in this project yet (step 1). Leave Application restrictions on None, and leave “Authenticate API calls through a service account” unchecked (that is for Vertex/Gemini).
If you see “The API developer key is invalid”: the usual cause is a Website application restriction. The Picker runs inside a Google-hosted iframe, so a referrer rule on your own domain often rejects it — set Application restrictions to None and test again. Then check API restrictions allows Picker + Drive, and that the key is from the SAME project as the Client ID above. Newly enabled APIs can take a minute.
Both values are public by design (safe in the browser) — the API key is not a secret and grants nothing on its own.

Security
Face ID / Touch ID unlock
Checking…
Unlock VENIA with Face ID on this device instead of typing the access code. The passkey is stored on this device only — it never leaves your phone, and the access code always works as a backup.
Team sign-in
Beta
Sign in with your VENIA email so we can move the app onto real accounts (and lock the shared data down). This doesn't change how you get in yet — the access code still works. First time: type your email and choose a password; that becomes your account.
Checking…
Reset the other founder's password
For when they are locked out. Choose a temporary password, tell them in person, and they can change it from Forgot password once email is set up. Every device still signed in as them is signed out.
Team & access
Access is per module and enforced by the database, not by hiding screens: a person is handed the modules you tick and the rest of the workspace is never sent to their browser at all. Only the two of you can grant or revoke.
Loading…
Give someone access
Granting access does not create a password. After granting, use Set password on their row — that makes the login and gives you the details to send them. Today is always included, otherwise they sign in to a screen that cannot load.

People & access
Everyone outside the two of you signs in with their own email and password at creator.veniacollection.com/?portal — and never receives the workspace itself. What they can reach is decided here and enforced on the server, so an account can only ever return what its group allows: cost, margin, factory and production data are not sendable to a portal at all. New leads still wait for your validation before entering the CRM. Revoke any time.

NFC Sample Scan
◎
Ready to Scan
Hold an NFC-tagged sample near your device's reader. The style will be identified automatically and added to the pull or checked back in.
iPhone? You don't need this screen — just tap the phone on the garment tag. Tags carry a URL (…/?tag=STY001, see 🏷 Tag URLs) that opens VENIA and logs check-out / check-in against the working pull automatically. This live scanner is for Android Chrome only.
Pull Details
Signature
Terms being accepted
Sign below
Sign with a finger or a stylus. This is kept with the pull and printed on the sheet.
Charge Pull Fee
Creates a Stripe invoice and emails it to the stylist. They pay via Stripe's hosted page. You'll see payment confirmation in your Stripe dashboard.
Generate a one-time Stripe payment link to share directly — by text, WhatsApp, or email.
Payment Link
Puts the amount on hold against the stylist's card without taking it. They enter the card on Stripe's page; the funds are reserved, not moved. When the samples come back you release it and they are never charged — or capture it, in whole, if something does not.
⚠ A card authorization expires on its own after 7 days — that is the card networks, not Stripe or us. If this pull runs longer than a week the hold will be gone before the samples are back, and there will be nothing left to capture. For a long loan, charge a deposit and refund it instead.
Record a payment received outside Stripe — cash, check, wire, or Venmo.
